name: Cistern of the First Hill
description:
Acts as a Cistern. Unlocks the Pilgrim Flask ability on non-siege military units, which can be activated to increase health regeneration by 25 per second for 6 seconds.
Flasks refill every 30 seconds to a maximum of 20 active flasks.

name: Foreign Engineering Company
description: Allows production of Nest of Bees, Huihui Pao, and Royal Cannons with Olive Oil. Mercenaries receive various unique technologies from their original civilization.

name: Golden Horn Tower
description: Periodically produces unlocked Mercenary Units for free.

name: Grand Winery
description: Acts as a Mill and Monastery. Nearby Villagers gather +60% Olive Oil from Berry Bushes and Olive Groves. Relics garrisoned generate Olive Oil instead of Gold.

name: Imperial Hippodrome
description:
Acts as a Stable. Contains the Triumph ability that can be activated with Supply Points to increase cavalry melee damage, move speed, and health regeneration. 
Comes with 10 Supply Points and generates one every 25 seconds. Earn more points by defeating enemy units.

name: Palatine School
description: When training Limitanei, Varangian Guards, Cataphracts, or Cheirosiphons there is a 30% chance to also spawn one at this Landmark.

name: Astronomical Clocktower
description: Acts as a Siege Workshop and produces siege engines with +50% health.

name: Barbican of the Sun
description:
Fires a long range hand cannon and adds arrowslits while garrisoned. Can be upgraded with weaponry and offers vision into Stealth Forests. 
Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.

name: Imperial Academy
description: Nearby buildings generate 100% more Gold from taxes. Imperial Officials produced here cost 30% less resources and can drop off taxes at this building.

name: Imperial Palace
description:
A spy Landmark with 28 tile sight radius and the Imperial Spies ability. Activate to view location of enemy workers for 15 seconds.
Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.

name: Spirit Way
description:
Dynasty technology can be researched here for -50% cost and +150% research speed. When a dynasty unit is killed, nearby units receive +20% attack speed and +20 health over 10 seconds.
Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.

name: Compound of the Defender
description:
Infantry units can build Stone Walls, Gates, and Towers. Reduces Stone cost of buildings and their emplacements by 25%.
Contains defensive technologies that ignore building and Imperial Age (IV) requirements.

name: Dome of the Faith
description: Acts as a Mosque. Produce Scholars at a discount of 55 Gold.

name: Hisar Academy
description: Acts as Madrasa. Generates +12 Food per minute based on the number of technologies researched. Does not apply to emplacements.

name: House of Learning
description: Grants no immediate bonus other than advancing to the next Age, but contains many unique technologies.

name: Palace of the Sultan
description: Automatically produces Sultan's Elite Tower Elephants. Garrison up to 4 Scholars in the Landmark to increase production speed.

name: Tower of Victory
description:
Acts as a Blacksmith.
Enables Tower of Victory, Mosques, and Madrasas to increase the attack speed of infantry by +20% when produced within their influence.

name: Abbey of Kings
description: Heals all nearby friendly units that are out of combat by +6 every 1 seconds. May also Crown a King, a powerful cavalry leader with a healing aura. Queues production of a free King upon completion.

name: Berkshire Palace
description: Acts as a Keep with increased health and powerful incendiary arrows. All weapons have 14.5 tiles of range.

name: Council Hall
description:
Acts as an Archery Range with all units and technologies. Works +100% faster.
Longbowmen produced from this landmark are -5% cheaper.

name: King's Palace
description: Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +10% faster.

name: The White Tower
description: Acts as a Keep with all the behaviors, technologies, and bonuses. Works 75% faster.

name: Wynguard Palace
description: Allows production of 4 battalions: Wynguard Army, Wynguard Rangers, Wynguard Raiders, and Wynguard Footmen.

name: Chamber of Commerce
description: Acts as a Market. Trains one free Trader for each economic technology researched.

name: College of Artillery
description:
Produces the Royal versions of the Cannon and Ribauldequin, which do +30% more damage and cost -25% gold.
Royal Cannons gain the Artillery Shot ability and Royal Ribauldequins gain the Fortify ability.
Contains Siege and Gunpowder technologies, trains units and researches technologies 50% faster.

name: Guild Hall
description: Generates and stores resources over time, the more resources stored the faster they are generated. Select between Food, Wood, Stone, or Gold. Generates stone at half the rate.

name: Red Palace
description:
Acts as a Keep. Features high-damage arbalest emplacements. Each garrisoned unit adds an additional arbalest.
Activates an Arbalest emplacement on all Keeps and Town Centers.

name: Royal Institute
description: Houses all technologies unique to the French. Research is -30% cheaper here and ignores Age requirements.

name: School of Cavalry
description: Acts as a Stable. All of your stables produce units +20% faster.

name: Aachen Chapel
description:
Inspires units in a large radius so long as a Prelate is garrisoned.
Acts as a drop-off point for all resource types.

name: Burgrave Palace
description:
Acts as a Barracks that produces 400% faster.
Infantry gains +50% charge damage.

name: Elzbach Palace
description:
Acts as a Keep with +50% health. All buildings within influence take -25% less damage.
Can train 8 Black Riders per Keep instead of 6.

name: Meinwerk Palace
description: Acts like a Blacksmith. Technology researched here costs -50% and researches 50% faster. Contains Technologies unique to this Landmark.

name: Palace of Swabia
description:
Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +200% faster and at -66% cost.
Cost to build this Landmark is reduced by -10%.

name: Regnitz Cathedral
description: Acts as a Monastery. All Relics generate +100% gold while garrisoned.

name: Abbey of Kings
description:
Heals all nearby friendly units that are out of combat by +6 every 1 seconds.
Ordain up to 4 Lords of Lancaster, powerful melee leaders which increase the max health of nearby military units by +5% each. Queues production of a free Lord of Lancaster upon completion.

name: Berkshire Palace
description:
Acts as a Keep with increased health and powerful incendiary arrows. All weapons have 14.5 tiles of range.
Increases the maximum damage granted by a House Unified to +6. Also grants 3 Earl's Guard upon being fully constructed.

name: King's College
description:
Reduces research costs of all technologies by -20%.
Contains unique Military technologies for House of Lancaster.

name: Lancaster Castle
description:
Defensive Landmark that can do a one-time muster of units in each Age. The cost of mustering units is reduced by 50 resources per Manor.
Grants all Manors +500 health and an arrowslit emplacement.

name: The White Tower
description:
Acts as a Keep with all the behaviors, technologies, and bonuses.
Grants 3 Earl's Guard upon being fully constructed.

name: Wynguard Palace
description: Allows the production of 4 battalions: Wynguard Army, Earl's Retinue, Garrison Command, and Gunpowder Contingent.

name: Castle of the Crow
description: Acts as a Castle. Can periodically spawn Treasure Caravans from selected neutral Trading Posts to provide a large amount of Food, Wood, Gold, and some Stone when reaching the Castle of the Crow.

name: Floating Gate
description:
Produces a Shinto Priest carrying a Yorishiro every 2 minutes. The first priest spawns instantly. Deposit up to 4 Yorishiro in buildings to provide unique bonuses.
 
Unlocks Shinto Shrines, which contains unique Shinto technologies and produces Shinto Priests.

name: Koka Township
description: Can produce Shinobi espionage units which specialize in scouting, sabotage, and assassination. Queues production of a free Shinobi upon completion.

name: Kura Storehouse
description: Universal drop-off location that creates a Farm around the Landmark every 50 seconds — generates Wood instead when farmland becomes full.

name: Tanegashima Gunsmith
description: Stockpiles weapon supplies every 30 seconds that can be used to instantly produce gunpowder units - comes with 2 stockpiles. Produces Ozutsu, a unique heavy ranged gunpowder infantry with siege damage. Allows access to Ribauldequins.

name: Temple of Equality
description:
Produces Buddhist Monks and contains unique Buddhist technologies. Buddhist Monks and Buddhist Temples provide support in combat by decreasing enemy damage with Sohei's Sutra. Buddhist monks enhance the damage of nearby units when using Buddhist Conversion.
 
Also allows construction of 4 additional Buddhist Temples.

name: Chamber of Commerce
description: Acts as a Market. Trains one free Trader for each economic technology researched.

name: College of Artillery
description:
Produces the Royal versions of the Cannon and Ribauldequin, which do +30% more damage and cost -25% gold.
Royal Cannons gain the Artillery Shot ability and Royal Ribauldequins gain the Fortify ability.
Contains Siege and Gunpowder technologies, trains units and researches technologies 50% faster.

name: Guild Hall
description: Generates and stores resources over time, the more resources stored the faster they are generated. Select between Food, Wood, Stone, or Gold. Generates stone at half the rate.

name: Red Palace
description:
Acts as a Keep. Features high-damage arbalest emplacements. Each garrisoned unit adds an additional arbalest.
Activates an Arbalest emplacement on all Keeps and Town Centers.

name: Royal Institute
description: Houses unique technologies. Research is -30% cheaper here and ignores Age requirements.

name: School of Cavalry
description: Acts as a Stable. All of your stables produce units +20% faster.

name: Dragon Pavilion
description:
Grants a free Meng'an Mouke Emplacement to all Town Centers and comes with a Meng'an Mouke Emplacement.
Trains Emissaries at a 33% discount and spawns 1 free Emissary upon completion.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Flower Pagoda
description:
Grants the ability to plant a Flower Garden which improves the gather rate of Villagers and the attack speed of non-siege military units as long as they are in the Flower Garden.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Great Pasture
description:
Acts as a War Stable and Grassland.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Great Wall Bastion
description:
Acts as a Keep with 4 mounted Bed Crossbow weapons instead of regular emplacements.
Increases the damage of all Bed Crossbow projectiles by +3.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Mountain Hall
description:
Acts as a Monastery and Monasteries are 50% cheaper.
Generate Karma by gathering resources near Monasteries. Losing units decreases Karma. At max Karma, receive the blessing of the Four Heavenly Kings for 60 seconds.
- Buildings regenerate 50 health per second.
- Villagers gather from Farms +75% faster.
- Relics generate +300% more gold.
- Defenses attack +50% faster.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Cistern of the First Hill
description:
Comes with 4 charges for an ability to boost the work rate of military and research buildings. If used on a Mining Camp, Lumber Camp, Mill, or Farm, begin earning 160 Gold, Wood, or Food over 60 seconds.
Recharges every 60 seconds.

name: Foreign Engineering Company
description: Allows production of Nest of Bees, Huihui Pao, and Royal Cannons for Silver.

name: Golden Horn Tower
description:
Defensive building equipped with Crossbow emplacements and large Line of Sight. Generates batches of Crossbowman for free over time. 
Detects units in stealth or disguises.

name: Grand Winery
description: Acts as a Mill and Monastery. Villagers gather Food 35% faster when affected by its aura. Relics garrisoned generate 100 Silver instead of Gold.

name: Imperial Hippodrome
description:
Acts as a Stable. A powerful Champion Scout, Horseman, and Riddari are trained for free over time.
Champions provide auras that increase damage of torches, enhance damage of cavalry, and inspire infantry to move faster.

name: Palatine School
description: Elite Cataphracts can be rapidly produced in batches at this Landmark for Silver.

name: Farimba Garrison
description: Enlist one of three units to enhance your roster for free: the Mansa Musofadi, Mansa Javelineer, or Freeborn Warrior. The other two can be enlisted for an additional cost.

name: Fort of the Huntress
description:
Acts as a Keep that shoots poison arrows. Infantry units nearby the Landmark enter Stealth for 30 seconds.
Musofadi Warriors and Musofadi Gunners gain First Strike, dealing more damage when breaking Stealth with an attack.

name: Grand Fulani Corral
description: Nearby cattle provide 16 Food per minute.

name: Griot Bara
description: Begin a festival for 300 Gold, providing global enhancements to Food gather rates, unit production speeds, or damage of torches and siege attacks. One festival may be active at a time.

name: Mansa Quarry
description: Generates 75 Gold per minute. Can be toggled to generate Stone instead.

name: Saharan Trade Network
description:
Acts as a Toll Outpost that comes with Defensive Javelin Emplacement researched. Unlocks Javelin Emplacement for Outposts.
All Traders and Trade Ships taxed will generate Food equal to the taxed Gold at this Landmark. All other Toll Outposts will generate 50% of taxed Gold as Food.

name: Deer Stones
description:
Deer Stones grant access to the Khan's Hunter at the Archery Range.
Instantly researches the Yam Network technology.

name: Khaganate Palace
description: Automatically spawns diverse armies from across the Mongol Empire and its dominions.

name: Kurultai
description: Nearby units within its aura heal +1 health every 1 second and gain an additional +20% damage.

name: Steppe Redoubt
description: Acts as a Ger. Gold dropped off at this Landmark is increased by +50%.

name: The Silver Tree
description: Acts as a Market. Production speed of Traders increased by +40% with a -40% reduced Gold cost.

name: The White Stupa
description:
Acts as an Ovoo and produces 240 Stone per minute without a Stone Outcropping.
Decreases the Stone cost of double unit production by -50%.

name: Aachen Chapel
description:
Inspires all Villagers in a large radius and increases their gather rate by +15%. 
Acts as a drop-off point for all resource types.

name: Burgrave Palace
description: Acts as a Barracks that produces units 35% faster and 35% cheaper. Researches technologies 35% faster.

name: Elzbach Palace
description: Acts as a Keep with +50% health. All buildings within influence take -25% less damage.

name: Meinwerk Palace
description: Acts like a Blacksmith. Technology researched here costs -50% and researches 50% faster. Contains Technologies unique to this Landmark.

name: Palace of Swabia
description:
Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +200% faster and at -66% cost.
Cost to build this Landmark is reduced by -10%.

name: Regnitz Cathedral
description: Acts as a Monastery. All Relics generate +100% gold while garrisoned.

name: Istanbul Imperial Palace
description: Doubles Imperial Council experience gained globally and increases the Vizier Point limit by +4.

name: Istanbul Observatory
description: Acts as a University. Improves the influence provided by the University and Blacksmith and production speed of the Grand Galley to +85%.

name: Mehmed Imperial Armory
description: Produces siege engines for free but with a longer train time.

name: Sea Gate Castle
description:
Acts as a Keep with a free Great Bombard emplacement. Defensive Strucutures deal 20% more damage.
All Keeps gain an aura that increases Trader and Trade Ship movement speed by +30% and armor by +8.

name: Sultanhani Trade Network
description: Acts as a Market. Comes with 3 Traders garrisoned and generates +28 Gold per minute for each one. Up to 10 Traders can be garrisoned.

name: Twin Minaret Medrese
description: Acts as a Mill. Grows 4 Berry Bushes which can be harvested +50% faster. Berry Bushes are regrown after 120 seconds if depleted.

name: Abbey of the Trinity
description: Acts as a Monastery. Reduces the cost of Warrior Monks by -50% and contains unique religious technologies.

name: High Armory
description: Decrease the cost of siege engines in nearby Siege Workshops by -20%. Contains unique siege engine technologies.

name: High Trade House
description:
Generates Gold like a Hunting Cabin with the value increased by +400%, without claiming any trees. Spawns a Huntable Deer every 60 seconds.
Villagers can drop off Food at this building.

name: Kremlin
description:
Acts as a Wooden Fortress that comes with Arrowslits, Castle Turret, and Castle Watch technologies.
Can Levy Militia every 80 seconds to the Capital Town Center. The number of Militia levied increases upon reaching the Castle Age.

name: Spasskaya Tower
description:
Acts as a Keep with all weapon emplacements and increased health.
Unlocks the building of Stone Walls, Stone Gates, and Stone Wall Towers.

name: The Golden Gate
description: Allows the exchange of resources at a favorable rate. Generates an additional exchange every 50 seconds.

name: Abbey of the Isles
description: Contains a Saint's Relic to provide area healing that increases in effectiveness for each Age. The relic can be moved to military and technology buildings to provide 135% increased research and production speed in addition to area healing. Cannot be moved to other Landmarks or buildings with defenses.

name: Dhùn Èideann
description: Equipped with the "Seven Sisters" cannons to defend the area. Produces gunpowder siege engines for 100 less Gold. Gunpowder siege weapons gain 1 tile range.

name: Snowdoun Gate
description:
Produces toggled infantry for free with a value of 190 resources per minute. 
Technologies researched at the Mustering Hall increase infantry production speed at this Landmark by 15%. When enemies are nearby, infantry hasten their deployment and gain an additional 15% production speed.

name: Stone of Destiny
description: Buildings constructed around the Stone of Destiny have 30% of their construction cost rebated as Gold. Does not apply to Landmarks. Grants early access to Kirkman that can create Fishponds.

name: Three Loch Lookout
description: Has a large line of sight and adds 3 muster charges for the Mustering Hall or Three Loch Lookout. The number of warriors received from mustering is increased by 75%. Comes with the option to muster a navy if constructed adjacent to water.

name: Tower of Skye
description: Acts as a Tower House equipped with arrowslits and a springald emplacement. Creates a local Stealth Forest and increases infantry damage by 15% while in Stealth Forests. Tower Houses unlock the ability to create additional Stealth Forests. Galleys unlock the Fairy's Chosen ability.

name: Castle of the Crow
description: Acts as a Castle. Reduces the cost of constructing Castles by 33%. Ranged siege units nearby any Castle gain +10% damage and +1 tiles range.

name: Koka Township
description: The Koka Township has the ability to scout a target area anywhere on the map and an ability to spawn a Shinobi ambush near one of your buildings or near Stealth Forest.

name: Ryokan
description: Increases Population by +60 and nearby units get a permanent healing buff, healing 4 every 6 seconds when out of combat.

name: Sake Brewery
description: The Brewery will create Toko-Koji Mats around itself which can be worked by Villagers to generate Gold. Villagers can drop-off Stone and Gold at this building.

name: Sword Hunt Statue
description: Daimyo cost decreased by 50% and increases Daimyo Aura attack speed bonus +15%. Level 3 Daimyo Estates will spawn levies +100% faster.

name: Temple of Equality
description: Acts as a Buddhist Temple that contains unique Ikko-ikki upgrades. Reduces the cost of training Ikko-ikki monks by 25%.

name: Compound of the Defender
description:
Reduces Stone cost of buildings by 25%.
Unlocks an additional upgrade to each Tughlaqabad Fort which further enhances health and Governor benefits.

name: Dome of the Faith
description: Acts as a Mosque and provides early access to Healer Elephants. Produces Imams and Healer Elephants at a discount of 65 Gold.

name: Hisar Academy
description: Acts as Madrasa. Generates 70 Food and 70 Gold per minute for every active Governor.

name: House of Learning
description: Grants no immediate bonus other than advancing to the next Age, but contains many unique technologies.

name: Palace of the Sultan
description: Appoint a Governor to the Palace of the Sultan and immediately gain their fourth tier benefactor bonus.

name: Tower of Victory
description: The Tower of Victory increases the attack speed of Elephants by +20% when produced from buildings within influence.

name: Baugr Fort
description:
Acts as a Barracks with all units and technologies. All Barracks work +25% faster and reduces Barracks technology costs by 15%.
Immediately upgrades Bondi and Berserkers to Hardened.

name: Gullinn Temple
description: Acts as a Sacred Grove. Allows Völur to establish Sacred Groves on Sacred Sites and unlock the Dreki Saga which increases Sacred Grove Berserker production by 15%.

name: Kongens Dør Cathedral
description: Acts as a Monastery. Increases population and maximum population by +10. Has a slowly expanding area that gathers a tithe of 12.5 Gold for each Longhouse every 30 seconds. Has a unique technology that further increases maximum population.

name: Konungr Hall
description:
Hosts a feast every 60 seconds which provides 10 Food +5 Food for each Longhouse and has a one-time Shield Maiden rally.
Can recruit Shield Maidens up to 1 +1 for each Longhouse constructed.

name: Rikets Nyckel Castle
description: Acts as a Keep that fires volleys of arrows. Increases population and maximum population by +10. Reduces the cost of all unit tier technologies by 50%. Recruits 10 Skåne Crossbowmen upon construction completion.

name: Valdemar Castle
description: Acts as a Keep. Grants the Danevirke technology which replaces Palisades with stronger walls that have +5 fire armor. Jylland Knights grant 20 more Gold when they are killed.

name: Jiangnan Tower
description:
Acts as a tax drop-off for Imperial Officials.
Military Buildings and Military Units produced within influence award progress towards free armies. Each free army requires progressively more resources to be spent than the last, until 12 armies have been produced.

name: Meditation Gardens
description:
Increases the resource value of nearby gold veins, stone outcroppings, and berry bushes by +5% every 30 seconds up to a maximum of +60%.
Trees are increased at a lesser rate of +2.5% up to +30%.
After 330 seconds, generates resources equal to 5% of the current resources in those nearby deposits. Additionally generates 5% of the maximum resources of each deposit when fully gathered.

name: Mount Lu Academy
description:
Imperial Officials collect tax twice as often and also collect 20% of taxes as Food.
Contains unique upgrades that greatly improve the Imperial Official unit.

name: Shaolin Monastery
description: Unique Monastery capable of producing Shaolin Monks. From the Yuan Dynasty onwards, Shaolin Monks can also be produced from Pagodas.

name: Temple of the Sun
description: Activate powerful abilities that improve speed, damage, range, or regeneration of specific units.

name: Zhu Xi's Library
description:
Hosts a range of highly unique upgrades.
Can unlock Yuan Raiders and Imperial Guards. Only 2 technologies can be researched.
